_comment: Deployment profile TEMPLATE. Placeholders only - never commit a filled-in copy.
Mount the real file from a ConfigMap and point SN_PROFILE_FILE at it, or override
individual keys with SN_PROFILE__<path>__<key> environment variables.
Secrets are NOT stored here: this file names the environment variables that hold
them, so the ConfigMap stays free of secret material and the Secret stays the
only place values live.
SHAPES ARE CODE, DESTINATIONS ARE DATA: an endpoint is defined entirely here.
To add one of a known shape (query/body), add an 'operations' entry; to add a
table, add an 'entities' entry. See the package README 'Onboard your endpoints'.
style: 'standard' is RFC 6749 client-credentials with Basic built from id and
secret. 'preencoded' is the variant flow. One live token call decides which a
gateway wants; the answer is this value, not a code change.
extra_headers: some gateways require a header on every business call (e.g. a
key id). Give it as a literal, or 'env:VAR_NAME' to resolve from the
environment. Nothing gateway-specific is named in the package itself.
Each operation declares HOW it is called. Fields:
method       GET | PUT | POST | ...
path         '/<namespace>/{table}'  ({table} substituted from the entity;
add {record} to address the record in the path; a fixed path
with no {table} is allowed for endpoints that do not target a
table).
shape        'query' (params on a GET) or 'body' (JSON on a write).
query_params (query shape) the EXACT logical params to send. Keep it to what
the endpoint accepts - some gateways error on extra params.
Known: display, query, fields, limit, offset,
exclude_reference_link. When 'fields' is omitted the field
allow-list is still enforced on the response.
gated        default: false for GET, true otherwise. Writes go through the
human approval gate.
base_url     optional per-operation override (different host/API version).
enabled      set false to keep an operation defined but unroutable.

create._comment: Disabled by default; enable once its endpoint is confirmed.

_comment: Logical name -> real table, plus deny-by-default field allow-lists.
A field absent from read_fields is never returned; a field absent from
write_fields can never be written. Empty write_fields = read-only entity.
display_field: the field a person refers to a record by (e.g. a number, or a
name for CMDB-style tables). coded_fields: {field: {code: label}} so answers
show real labels, not raw codes. Add one entity per table you are permitted
to touch.

params._comment: Wire names for query parameters. Defaults suit ServiceNow-style APIs.

_comment: keys_env names an environment variable holding a comma-separated ordered list
of HMAC signing keys. The first signs, all verify (zero-downtime rotation).
Sourcing from the secret manager is required. auto_approve_fields is empty by
default: nothing bypasses the gate unless a deployment opts a low-risk field in.

_correlation_field_comment: Optional field on the record where this package stamps the correlation id, joining the agent-side trail to the record. Leave null if no such field exists.
